_comment: Incident feeds, keyed by the camera source whose cities they serve. A feed belongs here only if its agency's terms permit this use, and only for a state whose cameras the project shows.

feeds.name: OHGO incidents
feeds.attribution: Incident data courtesy of the Ohio Department of Transportation (OHGO)
feeds.notes: Same terms and key as the OHGO cameras: public domain per ODOT, with a per-key rate cap this stays far under at one request every two minutes. OHGO publishes no report time, so a record is dated by when this server first saw it, which restarts the floor's decay if the server restarts. RoadStatus Closed implies closure. Planned work (ODOT's Repairs/Maintenance, or any construction or work-zone category) is listed but earns no floor; every other record is road-relevant.
